# TheFatCat User Documentation

> TheFatCat is a new experimental DeFi protocol that combines meme culture with a decentralized trading-tax routing mechanism.

## Definitions & Architecture
- [Introduction](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/): Protocol overview, reward reserves and time-weighted positions.
- [Definitions & Notation](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/definitions.html): Symbols, units, terminology and accounting conditions.
- [Terminology](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/definitions/terminology.html): Product terms and their meaning in use.
- [Symbols & Calculation Basis](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/definitions/notation.html): Principal, seniority, reward shares and meal references.
- [Accounting Constraints](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/definitions/invariants.html): Principal isolation, allocation limits and funding for settled rewards.
- [Design Background](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/background/paradigm-shift.html): Pass-through rewards compared with reserve-based allocation.
- [Prior Art](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/background/prior-art.html): Related mechanisms and links to Curve, Pendle and Synthetix documentation.
- [Reservoir Model](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/background/reservoir-model.html): Reserve allocation and the assumptions behind the decay model.
- [Time Weighting](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/background/time-weighting.html): Position duration, the seniority ladder and relative reward weights.
- [Design Principles](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/background/principles.html): Principal separation, reward accounting and operating limits.
- [System Topology](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/topology.html): Fund routes, position activation and the steps from allocation to claiming.
- [Asset Flows](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/topology/asset-flows.html): QQQB receipt, conversion, revenue splits and upstream authority boundaries.
- [Procurement & Claims](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/topology/claim-pipeline.html): Ordered purchases, oracle checks, settlement records and claiming settled rewards.
- [State Machine & Intervals](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/topology/state-machine.html): Transaction-driven meal advancement and frozen interval weights.

## Protocol Mechanics & Fees
- [How the Machine Runs](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/protocol/how-the-machine-runs.html): A walkthrough connecting revenue, Belly reserves, seniority, diets, settlement and FEED maintenance.
- [Tax Routing & Fees](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/protocol/fees.html): QQQB tax receipt, conversion rewards and the 85% Belly / 15% Ops split of remaining revenue.
- [The Belly](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/protocol/belly.html): Unreserved-balance allocations, the decay model and a safety cap on concentrated outflows after settlement delays.
- [Meals & Seniority](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/protocol/meals-and-seniority.html): Position weights, the 1-to-22 seniority ladder and current-interval exit forfeiture.
- [Procurement & Execution](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/protocol/execution.html): Global oldest-meal priority, TWAP checks, fallback conditions and claim boundaries.

## User Guides & Operations
- [Staking & Positions](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/guides/staking.html): 100,000 FATCAT entry floor, activation and position ownership.
- [Diets & Claiming](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/guides/diets-and-claiming.html): Enabled reward assets, batch claims and native BNB unwrapping.
- [Emergency Exit Guide](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/guides/emergency-exit.html): Direct contract calls for principal redemption and claiming settled rewards without the website.
- [Time-Seniority Certificates](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/guides/seniority-certificates.html): Future ERC-721 NFTs representing time-based seniority, minted by staking-position holders burning FATCAT; further details will be announced later.
- [FEED & Decentralized Maintenance](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/guides/community-keeper.html): Public FEED maintenance and qualifying conversion rewards of 1/38 of WBNB output, rounded down.

## Security & Governance
- [Custody & Accounting Boundaries](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/safety/custody.html): Core fund access, upstream recovery powers and rounding limits.
- [Testing & Validation](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/safety/audits-and-hardening.html): Current protections and the scope of internal regression and invariant tests.
- [Operational Monitoring](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/safety/monitoring.html): Monitoring measures, emergency response and user guidance.
- [Risks & Operating Conditions](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/safety/risks-and-status.html): Opening rules, issuer dependencies and settlement delays without fixed payment guarantees.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- [FAQ & Limitations](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/faq.html): Questions about staking, rewards and operating limits.
- [Staking & Positions FAQ](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/faq/staking.html): Variable rewards, principal redemption, position isolation and entry thresholds.
- [The Belly & Release FAQ](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/faq/belly-and-release.html): Upstream inflows, reserve allocations, outflow windows and reward outflow authorization.
- [Seniority & Diets FAQ](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/faq/seniority-and-rewards.html): The launch warmup, separate seniority progression, diet changes and claims.
- [Security & Custody FAQ](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/faq/security-and-safety.html): Direct contract access, core custody boundaries and upstream permissions and their effects on users.

## Whitepaper & Models
- [Whitepaper](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/whitepaper.html): Protocol architecture and models in the whitepaper.
- [Math Overview](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/whitepaper/math-overview.html): Allocation and weight equations, model assumptions and accounting bounds.
- [Whitepaper Downloads](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/whitepaper/downloads.html): English and Chinese PDF snapshots.

## Notices & Links
- [Notices & Disclaimers](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/notices.html): Protocol status, risk disclosures and legal boundaries.
- [Risk Disclaimers](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/notices/risk-disclaimers.html): Contract, market, liquidity and external dependency risks.
- [Regulatory Status](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/notices/regulatory-status.html): Tokenized asset issuer and jurisdictional limitations.
- [Official Links](https://thefatcatofficial.github.io/TheFatCat-docs/links.html): Application, community and technical links.
